name: Daily ZEN - Meditation (Kankyo Tannier)
reason: The channel is Zen nun Kankyo Tannier's own (dailyzen.fr), but it is barely active: only three uploads in the last two years (clips of about one, three and five minutes; the last talk-length video is from 2021). Fails the 'about 3 evergreen videos in 2 years' rule. Her site allows us and has a contact form if she is wanted later as an individual.
